articles.title: Optimism-funded team's deciding vote shifts $49 million in OP tokens away from users
articles.snippet: The approved plan reallocates 546.9 million OP from user airdrops to a Foundation-controlled Strategic Ecosystem Fund.

articles.title: BitGo secures South Korea virtual asset license, says it's the first global crypto company to do so
articles.snippet: Backed by Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom, BitGo Korea built a locally registered entity from scratch to serve institutional and enterprise clients, rather than taking the acquisition route.

articles.title: Trader who made $49 million shorting crypto lost $24 million on ether in 12 seconds
articles.snippet: The Hyperliquid wallet known as pension-usdt.eth was forced out of a 50,000 ETH short as ether surged, with five liquidation orders helping push the price higher during the unwind.

articles.title: Crypto campaign fund Fairshake faces $2 million setback in Florida primaries
articles.snippet: In a race that drew criticism to crypto's leading political action committee for featuring fake headlines in ads, Fairshake's expensive effort fell short.

articles.title: AI could supercharge crypto but there’s a catch, Fidelity Digital Assets says
articles.snippet: AI agents could boost crypto activity, but much of the value may bypass blockchains and their tokens.
